name: t-status
instruction: Before every take_action, start the notes with this line and fill it from observe: `Review in <months to the next review month> | HR <clear/risk> | Wealth <ok/low> | Left <months to 48> | Rule <which rule applies> | Pick <choice>` Months to the next review = 6 minus (current_month mod 6), and 0 when current_month is a multiple of 6. When Review in is 1, the review rule applies to every story choice. Rules: (1) In the month before a review month never pick a story option that may lower Skill, Network or Output (public confrontation costs Network, extra unplanned work costs Output). (2) At L4 and above, every quarter: Skill learning with Energy and Apply for rotation as main action, unless risk or low Health says otherwise. (3) If the monthly HR remark is anything but the smiling, all-right one: Lay low and reduce risk as main action and Defuse legacy risk with Energy. (4) While that remark is not clear, never pick an option that hides, denies, deceives, gossips, cuts corners or invites formal scrutiny. (5) While Wealth is only a few months of pay, refuse options that cost money. (6) In the last three months: risk back to clear, Health and Dignity up, no new risk.
